SET(H_FILES
    PRManTestCmd.h
)

SET(CXX_FILES
    PRManTestCmd.cpp
    main.cpp
)

SET(SOURCE_FILES ${CXX_FILES} ${H_FILES})

INCLUDE_DIRECTORIES("..")

ADD_MAYA_CXX_PLUGIN(prmanTest ${SOURCE_FILES})

IF(DEFINED ALEMBIC_PRMAN_FOUND AND ALEMBIC_PRMAN_FOUND)
    TARGET_INCLUDE_DIRECTORIES(prmanTest PRIVATE ${ALEMBIC_PRMAN_INCLUDE_PATH})
    TARGET_LINK_LIBRARIES(prmanTest PRIVATE ${ALEMBIC_PRMAN_LIBPRMAN})
    TARGET_COMPILE_DEFINITIONS(prmanTest PRIVATE USE_PRMAN)
ENDIF()

TARGET_LINK_LIBRARIES(prmanTest
    ${MAYA_LIBRARIES}
    ${CORE_LIBS}
)

set_target_properties(prmanTest PROPERTIES
    INSTALL_RPATH_USE_LINK_PATH TRUE
    INSTALL_RPATH ${CMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX}/lib)

INSTALL(TARGETS prmanTest
        DESTINATION maya/plug-ins)
